Native CUDA headers from vLLM v0.31.0, commit
db9527a46873454610df6dbedf79a36d6bf1a7f6:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/v0.31.0/csrc

Original paths are preserved below this directory. All original copyright
and Apache License notices are retained; LICENSE is the upstream license.
The MoE kernel is adapted by vLLM/Neural Magic from Elias Frantar's Marlin.
Copyright contributors to the vLLM project; Marlin copyright (C) 2024 Elias Frantar.

Garnet adaptations:
- scalar type namespace renamed to garnet_marlin_types;
- scalar validation uses std::invalid_argument, removing Torch headers;
- MarlinScalarType template ID uses int64_t through ScalarTypeId (Windows
  long is 32-bit);
- kernel namespace is selected with MARLIN_NAMESPACE_NAME in the caller.

No Torch or vLLM runtime is linked. Only BF16-activation MXFP4/E8M0 kernel
specializations are instantiated by Garnet. Weight layout conversion is
implemented in Garnet's native adapter with attribution to the upstream
gptq_marlin_repack.cu, marlin_utils.py and marlin_utils_fp4.py mappings.
